meta.name: add-emacs
meta.description: Add Emacs as a channel. Opens an interactive chat buffer and org-mode integration so you can talk to NanoClaw from within Emacs (Doom, Spacemacs, or vanilla). Local HTTP bridge — no bot token or external service needed.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 让 Emacs 直连 AI 助手,对话无需离开编辑器
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果离不开 Emacs,想在编辑器里随时向 AI 提问。
copy.tagline_en: Chat with your AI assistant right inside Emacs without switching tools
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you live in Emacs and want AI help without leaving your editor.

howto.what: 在 Emacs 里开一个聊天 buffer,可以边写代码边向 NanoClaw 提问;也能把选中的代码片段或某个 org 标题发过去,回复以子标题形式直接写回原文件。回答按 markdown 输出,由插件转成 org 语法。
howto.when: 装好适配器并设置 EMACS_ENABLED=true 后,在 Emacs 中按 C-c n c 打开聊天 buffer,或用 C-c n o 发送当前 org 标题/区域时接管。

say.text: 帮我看看这个函数为什么报错
say.note: 在聊天 buffer 里提问,回复显示在 buffer 中

改写我选中的这段草稿,用中文

howto.what_en: After setup, Emacs gets a chat buffer and org-mode integration: ask NanoClaw questions while coding, or send a region/org subtree and the reply lands as a child heading in your org file. Markdown replies are converted to org syntax.
howto.when_en: Once EMACS_ENABLED=true and the Lisp client is loaded, it takes over when you open the chat buffer (C-c n c) or send the current org heading/region with C-c n o.

say_en.note: Ask in the chat buffer; the reply shows there
